title: hieracium glaucinum subsp. cispadanum
intro: Hieracium glaucinum subsp. cispadanum, commonly known as Mountain Hawkweed, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). The health benefits of Mountain Hawkweed include its potential in reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpene lactones (e.g., hieracol and glaucolide), that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. These bioactive constituents may contribute to the plant's ability to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress.
